text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- More than 102,000 candidates to stand in local council elections due on June 13.
- Moroccan tennis player Hicham Arazi qualifies for third round of France's Roland Garros tournament.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali meets Azeddine Laraki, Secretary General of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference (OIC) over action plan to better serve interests of Islamic countries.
- Agriculture Minister Hassan Abou Ayoub said about 11,000 hectares (27,500 acres) of crops have been damaged by storms.
- Italian and Moroccan MPs team up to promote relations between the two countries.
- Morocco and Germany sign accord to work jointly in order to restore and microfilm the north African country manuscripts.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali and Spanish counterpart Jose Maria Aznar expected to meet on June 4 in Madrid.
